read_file.description: Read the contents of a file at the given path.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file.

write_file.description: Write content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file.

edit_file.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string with a new string. Use this for targeted code changes instead of rewriting the whole file.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file.

old_string.description: The exact string to find (case-sensitive, whitespace-sensitive).

delete_path.description: Delete a file or an empty directory.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file/directory.

delete_recursive.description: Recursively delete a file or directory tree. Use with caution.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file/directory.

list_directory.description: List files and directories inside a given directory.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the directory.

glob_files.description: Find files matching a glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.ts', 'src/**/*.py').

base_path.description: Directory to search from (default: current directory).

create_directory.description: Create one or more directories (like mkdir -p).

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the directory.

search_code.description: Search for a text pattern across files in the project using ripgrep-like search.

pattern.description: The text or regex pattern to search for.

max_results.description: Maximum number of result lines to return.

run_command.description: Run a shell command and return its output. Always set a reasonable timeout. Avoid destructive commands (rm -rf, etc.).

workdir.description: Working directory for the command (default: server CWD).

git_status.description: Show the working tree status (git status).

git_diff.description: Show staged and unstaged changes (git diff).

staged.description: If True, show only staged changes (git diff --cached).

max_count.description: Maximum number of commits to show.

files.description: File(s) to stage (space-separated, or '.' for all).

git_commit.description: Commit staged changes with a message (git commit).

git_create_branch.description: Create and switch to a new git branch (git checkout -b).

init_context.description: Initialize or auto-detect project context. Scans project files to detect tech stack, languages, and frameworks.

get_context.description: Get the full project context as formatted text. Optionally filter by dot path (e.g. 'tech_stack.languages').

dot_path.description:
Optional dot-notation path to get a specific field
      (e.g. 'project.name', 'tech_stack.languages').
      Leave empty to get the entire context.

update_context.description: Update a specific field in the project context using dot notation (e.g. 'project.description', 'conventions.code_style').

add_to_context_list.description: Add an item to a list field in the context (e.g. tech_stack.languages, key_files, active_tasks, goals).

item.description: Item to add (string, or JSON for complex items).

add_key_file.description: Register a key file with its purpose in the project context.

file_path.description: Path to the file (relative to project root).

details.description: Optional extended notes about the file.

add_task.description: Add an active task to the project context.

status.description: One of: pending, in_progress, blocked, completed.

add_decision.description: Log an architecture decision record (ADR) in the project context.

export_context_markdown.description: Export the project context as a Markdown document for sharing with other LLMs and AI tools.

remove_context_item.description: Remove an item from a list in the project context by index.

index.description: Zero-based index of the item to remove.

reset_context.description: Reset the project context to default values (clears all data).

project_info.description: Get information about the current project environment.

get_prd.description: Retrieve a PRD document (PRD, VISION, SCOPE, REQUIREMENTS). Returns the content of the specified document.

document.description: Which document to read — PRD, VISION, SCOPE, or REQUIREMENTS.

update_prd.description: Create or update a PRD document (PRD, VISION, SCOPE, REQUIREMENTS).

document.description: Which document to write — PRD, VISION, SCOPE, or REQUIREMENTS.

content.description: The full markdown content of the document.

summarize_prd.description: Summarize key requirements from PRD documents into a concise bullet list.

compare_work_to_prd.description: Compare current project context and tasks against PRD requirements to check alignment.

get_current_phase.description: Get the current active phase and its status.

set_phase.description: Set the current active development phase. Only tasks in this phase are considered 'in scope'.

phase_name.description: Name of the phase (e.g. 'Phase 4 — Activity Creation').

complete_phase.description: Mark the current phase as completed and optionally advance to the next phase.

notes.description: Summary of what was accomplished in this phase.

next_phase.description: Mark current phase as complete and advance to the next phase in sequence.

list_phases.description: List all phases and their status (completed, active, pending).

add_milestone.description: Define a milestone with a target date and associated features.

features.description: Comma-separated list of key features for this milestone.

list_milestones.description: Show all milestones and their status.

create_task.description: Create a new task with phase, priority, dependencies, and description.

phase.description: Which phase this task belongs to (leave empty for current phase).

priority.description: One of: critical, high, medium, low.

depends_on.description: Comma-separated task IDs that must be completed first.

update_task.description: Update a task's status, priority, or description by ID.

status.description: One of: pending, in_progress, blocked, completed, cancelled.

priority.description: One of: critical, high, medium, low.

complete_task.description: Mark a task as completed with optional notes.

next_task.description: Get the highest-priority task that is ready to work on (dependencies met, current phase).

blocked_tasks.description: List all tasks that are blocked, either by dependencies or explicitly.

list_tasks.description: List all active tasks, optionally filtered by phase or status.

status.description: Filter by status (pending, in_progress, blocked, completed).

priority.description: Filter by priority (critical, high, medium, low).

generate_handoff.description: Generate a session summary capturing what was done, what's next, and current project state for handoff to another AI.

session_summary.description: Brief summary of what was accomplished this session.

known_issues.description: Any bugs or issues the next session should know about.

get_last_handoff.description: Retrieve the most recent AI handoff document so a new AI session has full context.

list_handoffs.description: List all AI session handoffs with dates.

generate_project_brain.description: Generate a complete aggregated Project Brain dashboard showing current status, phase, active/blocked tasks, recent changes, and recommendations.

next_best_action.description: Intelligently calculate and recommend the next best task to work on based on phase, priority, dependencies, and file hints.

start_session.description: Start a development session. Loads state, PRD, active tasks, and latest handoff to generate a detailed Session Brief for the AI.

end_session.description: End the current session, update progress, and generate a handoff file (does not auto-commit changes).

prepare_commit.description: Analyze modified workspace files and generate a suggested conventional git commit message and summary for approval.

commit_changes.description: Stage all workspace changes and commit them to Git with the approved commit message.

validate_architecture.description: Scan the codebase and validate imports/technologies against the project's architectural guidelines and forbidden tools.

build_dependency_graph.description: Scan files and construct a complete mapping of dependencies and references in the project.

impact_analysis.description: Calculate direct and transitive downstream files affected if a given file is modified.

sync_workspace.description: Scan the physical workspace (Git diff, new files, current branch, commits) and compare to the Todo plan to auto-detect finished work.

verify_work.description: Perform deep sanity, test, git diff, and architecture checks against a task to output a reality verification dossier.

project_dashboard.description: Generate a unified Project Manager Dashboard combining phase state, todo progress, git status, architecture violations, and a project health score.

extract_requirements.description: Parse PRD markdown files to extract structured requirements and save them into requirements.json.

verify_requirements.description: Scan codebase to map requirement keywords and verify their implementation status and feature coverage.

verify_outcome.description: Perform outcome audits verifying user flows, business goals, and objective completion based on target tasks.

assess_project_readiness.description: Scan the workspace and evaluate its onboarding readiness score (0-100%) against required Project Brain documents.

project_readiness_report.description: Generate a formatted Markdown project readiness report showing missing files, scoring audit, and recommended actions.

bootstrap_project.description: Auto-generate template files and directories (PRD, milestones, active tasks, config yaml) to instantly onboard an unknown repository.

adopt_existing_project.description: Scan an existing legacy codebase (directories, package lists, readmes) and generate context, PRDs, milestones, and audit tasks.

doctor.description: Check the diagnostic health and configuration integrity of the Project Brain and MCP server.

reset_project_brain.description: Wipe all Project Brain configuration, tasks, and context metadata inside the selected project. Leaves git and source code untouched.

archive_project_brain.description: Archive current Project Brain settings and context files to .project_brain_archive/ before a reset or pivot, preserving history.

create_project_workspace.description: Create a new isolated project workspace directory, initialize git, bootstrap the project context/brain, and set up first milestone.

name.description: Name of the project directory to create.

project://context/json.name: Project Context (JSON)
project://context/json.description: The full project context document as JSON.

project://context/markdown.name: Project Context (Markdown)
project://context/markdown.description: The full project context as a Markdown document for sharing.

project-overview.description: A complete project overview prompt that injects the full project context for AI assistants.

code-review.description: Code review guidelines specific to this project's conventions and tech stack.

architectural-decision.description: Template for recording an Architecture Decision Record (ADR).

feature-plan.description: Template for planning a new feature with tasks, branch strategy, and milestones.
